observationsNotFindings: The doesNot list carries 'Does not take over DR-101, G14, G16, G24, or G29.' with G13 handled by its own separate line, 'Does not name G13 into required-now.' A mechanical comparison against registerRowNote, which does carry the full six-target form including G13, will report an inconsistency. It is not one: D-158's own phrasing for G13 is 'Does not name G13 into required-now' because G13 is reserved rather than named, so the split tracks the source. This shape is carried byte-identical from the dual-ACCEPTed v3, and v3's reviewer raised and defeated the same candidate finding.

OBL-G30-FX-AUTHORING carries rideStanding 'not-capable-of-riding as execution-only remainder' while its own reason cites D-056 clause 5 classing fixture authoring as design work. Read strictly, 'execution-only remainder' sits awkwardly against 'remains design work'. It is not a defect here: the operative field is leftoverDesign, which reads true and correctly keeps the obligation open, and the rideStanding string is byte-identical to frozen v3's, which passed dual ACCEPT. Flagging it as inherited wording rather than a v4 regression.

Occupancy v2's own reviewStatus field still reads AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW while the subject cites dual ACCEPT 0/0 of it. That is the frozen draft-time field rather than a contradiction — both review files exist at the pinned digests and both read ACCEPT with empty mustFix and shouldFix. A reviewer checking the standing against the artifact's own field alone would see a conflict that is not there.

This is the version where the family's two frozen anchors are pinned by the dispatch itself rather than only by the subject. Both reproduced exactly, which means the currency swap is the only moving part and the review could concentrate on it.

The four added doesNot entries map one-to-one onto the four attacks that are new at v4 — fixture-byte invention, identifier occupancy, v3 currency after the successor, and occupancy v1 currency. The successor anticipated its own attack surface rather than inheriting a generic guard list.

decision: ACCEPT — 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX. Thirty-five attacks run, thirty-five refuted against live bytes. The subject is unmoved at 3f3d84e0, mode 0444, 18409 bytes. Thirty-five digest checks pass with zero mismatches, and the two anchors the dispatch pinned independently, frozen leftover-join.v3 at 034ccef1 and frozen occupancy v2 at 371695b8, both reproduce exactly. The decisive test was the obligation delta, because a remasurement successor is exactly the vehicle for shrinking a leftover set under cover of a currency change: diffed against frozen v3's own bytes, the obligation ids, all six leftoverDesign flags, every rideStanding and the entire summary block are unchanged, and the doesNot list is strictly additive by four entries that map one-to-one onto this version's new attack surface. The currency swap itself is clean in both directions. v4's claim that v3 cited occupancy v1 was checked against v3 rather than v4's account of it: v3's only occupancy token is preview.v1 and it carries no parentReview at all, so the swap to occupancy v2 is a real correction. All nine currency sentences were enumerated; every sentence demoting v3 carries the 'after this successor is recorded' qualifier, and the two unqualified 'current' sentences are past-tense statements of what D-205 did, which live COORD and commit 477eee5d confirm. Nothing strands v3 at draft time and nothing keeps it current past its successor. leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded does not exist in the file, so the named closure attack has no surface; the leftover set is exactly ['OBL-G30-FX-AUTHORING'] and the six-member partition is exhaustive and disjoint. Zero occurrences of SATISFIES; all sixteen invention-token occurrences are negations with no pack identity, D9 code, or recipe content anywhere. The EE census is 7a/7b/7d at nine each with 6b, 7c and 7e at zero, matching D-158's grant exactly, and EE-7c's absence between two granted classes is positive evidence the grant was read. Live required-now is 28 of 28, the DR-G30 token is its own row's OPEN, the harness-cell carry is character-exact, naming v6 contains zero DR-G30, and basedOn.d254 is two sentences of custody with no lineage in it. Six cited review standings were opened rather than inferred, including four 'Codex not reviewed' absences tested by direct file check. docs/v2/implementation/ remains absent. Governing tree clean at start and end.
